inputs.text: A ceramic mug of hot tea on an oak desk beside a closed notebook. Soft morning window light from the left, plain warm-gray wall, close three-quarter view, entire mug visible, clear handle silhouette, faint steam above the tea, no text or logos.

inputs.label: Motion brief
inputs.text: Locked camera for five seconds. A thin wisp of steam rises slowly from the tea and curls gently in the window light. The mug, desk and notebook remain completely still. Preserve their shape and placement; no cuts, new objects or camera motion.
